backend/main.mo: Actor managing contact submissions and user profiles with access-controlled queries and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping meta‑tag addition tasks to affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and CSS variables defining OKLCH color system and dark mode styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file including Google Search Console verification meta tag and mounting point for the app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router setup defining all application routes under a SiteLayout root.
frontend/src/components/content/FormStat: UI banner component showing success or error messages with icons and color cues.
frontend/src/components/content/UpdateCa: Reusable card component displaying update metadata, category styling, and navigation to detail pages.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer with site info, quick links, state navigation buttons, and dynamic year handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Layout wrapper containing header, optional breadcrumbs, content outlet, and footer.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Generates breadcrumb navigation from the current URL path and renders links with icons.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Mobil: Implements a mobile slide-in navigation menu with search, main links, state links, and footer links.
frontend/src/components/navigation/SiteH: Renders the site header with logo, desktop navigation, search button, and mobile menu trigger.
frontend/src/content/seedUpdates.ts: Provides seed update items containing titles, metadata, and HTML bodies for education-related news content.
frontend/src/content/updateTypes.ts: Defines update categories, the UpdateItem interface, and a helper mapping categories to display labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, exposing identity, login, logout, and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a React Query mutation for submitting a contact form via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode, typography, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, services, commitments, disclaimer, and contact info while setting SEO metadata.
frontend/src/pages/AdmitCardsPage.tsx: Shows a list of admit card updates using UpdateCard components and sets appropriate page metadata.
Displays competitive exam categories and related updates with descriptive sections and SEO metadata.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides a contact form with validation, submission handling, status banners, and page metadata.
frontend/src/pages/DisclaimerPage.tsx: Presents the site's disclaimer with sections on information accuracy, verification, liability, and metadata.
frontend/src/pages/EducationNewsPage.tsx: Lists education news updates using UpdateCard components and includes icons, descriptions, and SEO metadata.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Serves as the homepage with category links, hero section, state shortcuts, and latest updates across categories.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Renders a 404 page with navigation options to return home or go back, and sets appropriate page metadata.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed content for a selected post, handles missing posts gracefully, and sets metadata based on post data.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Shows the site's privacy policy with structured sections and sets metadata for the page.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsPage.tsx: Lists exam result updates by category and displays a message when no results are available.
frontend/src/pages/SchemesPage.tsx: Displays government scheme updates for students using category filtering and page metadata.
frontend/src/pages/ScholarshipsPage.tsx: Shows scholarship updates with national and state filters and includes a guide section for applying.
frontend/src/pages/SchoolEducationPage.t: Provides school education information and lists related updates across boards, exams, and resources.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Implements a search page that syncs the query with URL params, performs memoized searches on updates, and displays results or empty states.
frontend/src/pages/StatePage.tsx: Renders state-specific update listings with metadata, quick links, and category browsing based on the provided state slug.
frontend/src/seo/usePageMeta.ts: React hook that updates document title and description meta tag whenever page metadata changes.
frontend/src/utils/searchUpdates.ts: Provides normalized text search across updates and utilities for sorting updates by date.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters for routing and state management.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin usage for the project.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing state, requirements, features, and pending tasks related to adding a site-wide Google Search Console verification tag.
